notes: Fresh V1 token set for the HOney rebuild (iOS + Web). Platform-neutral.
Cool-blue accent family is re-derived for continuity with the legacy feel (pale-blue backgrounds, translucent white cards, navy text, ocean-blue accents) but does NOT reuse legacy RGB values.
All text/semantic colors meet WCAG 2.1 AA (>= 4.5:1) on both background and surface of their mode; measured ratios are recorded in each token's contrast field.

background.description: App background — pale cool blue, continuous with legacy pale-blue gradient feel

surfaceTranslucent.description: Translucent card/bar over background; pair with backdrop blur (iOS material .thinMaterial equivalent)

accentSoft.description: Soft accent fill — chips, selected rows, highlights; use textPrimary or accent on top

line.description: Hairlines, separators, input borders (non-text, AA not required)

surfaceTranslucent.description: Translucent card/bar over background; pair with backdrop blur

accent.description: Lifted ocean blue for dark mode

accentSoft.description: Soft accent fill for dark mode; use textPrimary or accent on top

ios.description: System font; use .system / SF Pro Text & Display automatically by size

web.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

caption.description: Metadata, timestamps, helper text — use textSecondary

spacing.description: 4-pt base scale; screen gutters default to lg (16)

radius.description: sm: chips/inputs, md: buttons, lg: cards, xl: sheets/modals, full: pills/avatars

standard.description: Transitions: navigation, sheet present, list changes
Default ease-out-ish curve; iOS: use spring(response 0.35, dampingFraction 0.9) for interactive transitions

none.description: Default — internal UI stays minimal; prefer line + surface over shadows

elevation.description: Shadow color is derived from light textPrimary navy at low alpha; in dark mode rely on surface tone difference instead of shadows
